description: Source-backed temporal override candidates from focused review of remaining military overlay membership candidates.

candidate_overrides.name: Pollença Seaplane Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Official Spanish Air and Space Force page says Base Aérea de Pollensa was created in 1937 and remains an air-force unit.

candidate_overrides.name: Coast Guard Station
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Focused review matched the coordinates to the former Swanage/Peveril Point coastguard lookout; NCI opened there in 1995 after the former coastguard use.

candidate_overrides.name: Deal Coast Guard Station
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Dover heritage material cites Deal coastguard presence from at least 1841; current HM Coastguard rescue-station listing confirms ongoing facility use.

candidate_overrides.name: Kisarazu Japan Coast Guard Station
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Japan Coast Guard Chiba history records Kisarazu office established on 1969-04-01; JCG office list confirms current address.

candidate_overrides.name: Philippine Coast Guard Detachment
candidate_overrides.source_notes: CGSS Liloan is attested in 2019 PCG/NDRRMC reporting and later Southern Leyte PCG coverage.

candidate_overrides.name: Coast Guard
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Official USCG history says Station Burlington was commissioned in 1948 and is still in operation.

candidate_overrides.name: Caserne Dumont-d'Urville
candidate_overrides.source_notes: French heritage record says the barracks were built circa 1895; Falaise bulletin says the city took possession in 1946 and later military reoccupation did not happen.

candidate_overrides.name: Caserne Hamelin
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Cadomus history says Caserne Hamelin was built from 1720 through 1835 and destroyed in the Battle of Caen, with remaining traces cleared by 1946.

candidate_overrides.name: Caserne Pérignon
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Toulouse archives place construction in the late 19th/early 20th century; Service Public lists a current defense service at Caserne Pérignon.

candidate_overrides.name: Caserne Teyssier
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Local reporting says the site was assigned to the Ministry of War in 1818 and partly returned to the city in 2001-2002; Service Public still lists a current defense recruitment office there.

candidate_overrides.name: Caserne Valence
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Mérimée record says Caserne Valence was installed from 1875 and remains assigned to the defense ministry/gendarmerie.

candidate_overrides.name: Lathbury Barracks
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Focused review found historical/ex-military use and current civilian/government tender evidence; end year is a conservative latest-confirmed military-use marker pending stronger source review.

candidate_overrides.name: South Barracks House
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Gibraltar heritage page says South Barracks was the oldest British Army barracks in mainland Europe by 1990 and was handed to the Gibraltar Government in 1991.

candidate_overrides.name: Royal Guard barracks
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Royal Court of Norway verifies the King's Guard current permanent duty at Huseby military camp; exact facility opening year remains approximate pending stronger source review.
